blurb: A morning brief of what's overdue and due today.

definition.name: Morning brief
definition.description: Writes a short daily note of overdue tasks and tasks due today.
definition.instructions: Find overdue tasks and tasks due today in the project. Write a brief note titled 'Morning brief — <date>' listing: Overdue (soonest first, with priority), Due today, and a one-line suggested focus for the day. If nothing is overdue or due, say so in one line.
